serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Someone’s calling me, that’s unusual.
It’s Annalie.
I wonder what that’s about.
Lady Annalie: Heyo! Do you have time to talk?
You: I do. What’s up?
Lady Annalie: I wanted to ask you something. It’s pretty weird, but something’s been on my mind for quite some time. Do you mind? 
You: Depends on the question, I guess.
Lady Annalie: Right, makes sense. 
Lady Annalie: Anyway, I wanted to ask you about Melissa…
What?! Is she suspecting something? 
I had a bad feeling after our talk a few weeks ago, but this might be quite bad…
Why did Melissa force me to gaslight our friends? Why put all that burden on me?
You: About Melissa? Sure, I don’t mind.
Lady Annalie: Don’t you have a feeling that she’s trying to distance herself from us? She almost completely stopped answering my messages.
You: Maybe she’s busy with her new job? I heard it’s pretty tough…
Lady Annalie: That may be, but I just thought…{{wi}} I thought that we were closer than that…
I can hear her pain in her slightly trembling voice. I don’t think Melissa even realized just how much she was loved.
You: I’m sorry that you feel that way. Long-distance relationships aren’t easy and not everyone can make them work.
Lady Annalie: …
You: But hey, you always have us to rely on!
Lady Annalie: Haha! I appreciate the sentiment, but don’t get too ahead of yourself! You are still my client first! A client with benefits, I suppose! 
You: That doesn’t sound right…
